'''2000 Death Star II Pre-Release (Mountain View)''' was a [[Death Star II (expansion)|Death Star II]] pre-release tournament in Mountain View, California, in June 2000. [[Cat Ceder]] posted his Dark deck from it on DeckTech, saying "I went 2/2 with this deck" and pointing to his tournament report "TR Mt.View CA 062400" (24 June 2000).<ref name="dt-7975">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/7975 DII - Pre-Release Deck], DeckTech (Cat "CatLoneRogue" Ceder, 27 June 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/7975/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/7975/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

== Format ==
* '''Type:''' Pre-release
* '''Date:''' June 2000 (24 June 2000 per Ceder's report title)
* '''Site:''' Mountain View, California

== Decklists ==
Players posted these lists on DeckTech as decks they played at the event; the posted list may differ slightly from the one played.

* [[2000 Death Star II Pre-Release (Mountain View) Cat Ceder DII - Pre-Release Deck]] ([[Cat Ceder]], [[Dark]]; 2–2) — "I went 2/2 with this deck"
